prose: This first on-screen meeting of minds between Stellium7 and Slick Dissident is sure to set off some synchronistic fireworks. Mike Wilkerson (Stellium7 on YouTube) has uncovered incredible mysteries in stone, including evidence of possible titanic-sized ancient bodies, petrified as modern mountains and rock formations. Tune in for some good old-fashioned free-weaving, vibe ranting, philo-sophic fun.
